svg.title: A possible Two-Rail script family: comparative atlas
svg.desc: Nine fictional stages around Carlo's original Classical script, including a free alphabet and compositional syllable blocks. Identical modern keys din rento ghma and n p s r w are drawn in every hand; bare consonants have an explicit empty-nucleus sign in Harbor.

g.text: Nine stages · the same phonetic keys · a ribbon, a free alphabet, and compound syllable signs
